verdict.rationale: Fellow's own feature page says users automatically receive AI meeting summaries, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting, which are AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the product. The pricing page also lists AI summary, AI action items, and "Ask Fellow". The MCP server and the API-to-LLM pipeline happen in external tools, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of in-product AI insights such as how "Ask Fellow" works, insights spanning multiple meetings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
